text_differences.a_text: This Agreement is made between Acme Corp and the Vendor for the supply of goods.
text_differences.b_text: This Agreement is made between Acme Corp and the Vendor for the supply of goods.

text_differences.a_text: The vendor shall deliver the goods within 30 days of order confirmation.
text_differences.b_text: The vendor shall deliver the goods within 45 business days of order confirmation.

text_differences.a_text: Either party may terminate this agreement with 60 days written notice.
text_differences.b_text: Either party may terminate this agreement with 30 days written notice.

text_differences.a_text: Payment is due on receipt of invoice.
text_differences.b_text: Payment is due within 15 days of receipt of invoice.

text_differences.a_text: This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
text_differences.b_text: This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

text_differences.a_text: All disputes shall be resolved through binding arbitration in New York.
text_differences.b_text: All disputes shall be resolved through binding arbitration in Chicago.
The vendor must maintain liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 throughout the term.
